notes.title: The Simplified Chinese version of "My Dear Frankenstein" is now available!
notes.notes:
The simplified Chinese version of "My Dear Frankenstein" has been added. If you have already purchased the game, you can continue to play it.

Come on, let's go. While the darkness is gentle.
“My Dear Frankenstein" is an exploratory adventure game that wanders around the city at night.
Become a newborn monster and search for lost pieces of your heart!

My Dear Frankenstein -English Edition- is available here.
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1742500/
itch.io : https://moonchimel.itch.io/my-dear-frankenstein
